component: Release recipient and notification scope alignment

quotes.text:
for address in emails:
            command += ["--address", address]
        command += [
            # We wrap this in `{'task-reference': ...}` below
            "--task-group-id",
            "<decision>",
        ]

        job["scopes"] = ["notify:email:{}".format(address) for address in emails]
        job["run"] = {
            "using": "mach",
            "comm-checkout": True,
            "clone-with": "hg",
            "sparse-profile": "mach",
            "mach": {"task-reference": " ".join(map(shell_quote, command))},

text: 1109's transform uses the resolved recipients both for --address arguments and notify:email scopes. The subcommand then calls the shared notify utility, which uses the task proxy when available and otherwise configured environment options. Keep task authority and recipients aligned so adding a recipient is not only a body or argument edit. This is the checked implementation contract; no credentials were loaded and no external email was sent.
title: Match email recipients with the generated Taskcluster notification scopes
